module: Node "AI Disable" (color ai, repeat_p_duration). Disables the AI mode of a vehicle. Input: aiVehId (no value = player vehicle). Data: useScriptStop (false: uses ai:scriptStop instead of ai.setState disabled), handBrakeWhenFinished, straightenWheelsWhenFinished.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

init.desc: Initializes the node's three data fields to false.

work.desc: Sends ai:scriptStop(handBrake, straightenWheels) to the vehicle if useScriptStop, otherwise ai.setState({mode = "disabled"}).
